name: Supreme Industries Ltd.
business_summary: India's largest plastic-products maker: plastic piping systems (PVC/CPVC/HDPE for plumbing, agri, infra, ~70% of volume), packaging films, industrial moulded components, consumer products (furniture, material handling) and composite LPG cylinders. Q2 FY27 revenue Rs 3,361 cr (+40%), OPM 12.8%, PAT Rs 262 cr (+59%); piping volume +24% in Q2 and +23% in October after a -13.5% Q1 caused by an unprecedented PVC price cut. FY27 guidance cut: piping volume +13% (from 15-17%), total volume +10%, revenue Rs 13,500-14,000 cr, OPM 14-14.5%, capex Rs 1,000 cr; six new plants by Mar 2029. Debt-free, dividend payout ~43%.

revenue_mix.geography: India (plumbing, agri, infra); small exports (approx., model knowledge)

exposures.mechanism: PVC, PE and PP resins are ~70% of costs (estimate; PVC ~45%, PE ~18%, PP ~7%). Supreme re-prices after a 10-15 day lag, so a +10% polymer move raises costs ~7% but ~85% is recovered within a month; unrecovered 15% x 7% = ~1% of costs ~0.9% of revenue vs OPM 14% -> EBITDA -6.5%; EV/MCap 1.0; persistence 0.25 -> -1.6. Range includes slightly positive because rising prices create inventory gains in piping (while packaging films cannot pass on: Q2 packaging margin fell).

evidence.note: Packaging margins contracted as steep PE price increases could not be passed on; selling prices raised after 10-15 day gap
PVC and PP prices near peak, limited room for further increase

exposures.mechanism: Residual crude channel beyond the polymer-spread edge: PE/PP track crude and Middle East supply (a major supplier to India). Rising crude -> distributor restocking and inventory gains in piping (positive, short-lived) vs packaging/consumer squeeze (negative). Net ~0 with wide range; empirical +0.88 (t +1.5) is positive, which supports the inventory-gain reading. Do not combine with a polymer-price edge from the same Brent move twice in propagation.

evidence.note: PE prices linked to crude and disrupted Middle East supply

exposures.mechanism: West Asia is a major PE/PP supplier to India; escalation tightens supply and spikes polymer prices faster than packaging/consumer customers accept. Q2 evidence: packaging margins absorbed the hit. +1 escalation -> polymer +10% spike in packaging/consumer (~20% of revenue) with 50% unrecovered -> ~1% of segment revenue lost -> EBITDA -3.5% in those segments; group effect ~-1.5.

evidence.note: Polyethylene prices up on crude and disrupted Middle East supply; packaging margin hit

exposures.mechanism: Plumbing/CPVC and furniture are ~25% of group revenue. +10% housing volumes -> +3% sales; fixed-cost leverage 1.5x -> EBITDA +4.5%; EV/MCap 1.0; persistence 0.5 -> +2.2 (rounded down).

evidence.note: Management sees healthy demand from housing and agriculture

exposures.mechanism: Agricultural/irrigation pipes ~25% of piping volumes plus farm-linked demand. +5 pp rural consumption growth -> farm pipe volumes +4% -> +1.2% group revenue; leverage 1.5x -> EBITDA +1.8%; Q2 piping volume +24% shows operating leverage in recovery; x1.0 x 0.5 + sentiment -> +2.

evidence.note: Piping volumes +24% in Q2, +23% in October

exposures.mechanism: Jal Jeevan Mission / Nal Se Jal is a key public-demand driver, but it is 'significantly lower than budgeted' as states fail to match central funds. +10% government capex (incl. state funds released) -> +2% volumes -> EBITDA +3%; x1.0 x 0.5 -> +1.5.

evidence.note: Nal Se Jal business significantly lower than budgeted; state governments not matching central funds

exposures.mechanism: India imports ~half of PVC resin; landed prices follow USD. +3% USD/INR -> resin +1.5-3% after pass-through lag; unrecovered 15% x 2% x 70% cost share ~0.2% of revenue -> EBITDA -1.5%; x1.0 x persistence 0.25 plus a margin-volume effect -> -0.6. Chairman explicitly cites rupee as a PVC price swing factor.

evidence.note: PVC price direction will depend on global economy and rupee vs dollar

exposures.mechanism: Anti-dumping duties on PVC resin imports raise raw-material cost for non-integrated pipe makers like Supreme (benefit goes to resin producers). +1 broad duties -> PVC +8% for ~3 months unrecovered at 20% -> EBITDA -5%; x1.0 x persistence 0.4 -> -2.0. Current India PVC ADD status not verified in this run (model knowledge: ADD was proposed in 2025; low confidence).

evidence.note: DGTR PVC suspension resin ADD case; status not re-verified

exposures.mechanism: Debt-free (interest Rs 28 cr TTM); rates act via the multiple (37x trailing) and housing/MSME demand. +25 bp -> -0.8.

evidence.note: Interest Rs 3 cr in Sep-26 quarter; ROCE 20.7%

exposures.mechanism: Monsoon (+10% above LPA) lifts kharif irrigation and rural piping offtake with a 1-2 quarter lag; agri ~25% of piping -> revenue +1% -> EBITDA +1.5% x 0.5 -> +0.8; plus sentiment -> +1.2.

supply_chain.counterparty: Reliance, IOC, Indian PVC/PE/PP producers and importers

supply_chain.note: Industry PVC volume fell 10% in H1 as organised players gained share
Channel stocking drives volumes around price moves

company_events.event: Union Budget FY28: Jal Jeevan Mission / housing allocations
PVC price movement (management says near peak, may rise slightly)
New plant commissioning (Jammu, Patna, Erode, Pondicherry, JNPT) - first fully operational by Mar 2028
